limitations: Delayed key only: no live key, no order and no open position.
Each observation is one run on one account on one day; it shows behaviour seen, not a documented guarantee.
Raw responses, ledgers and stream files stay private; only SHA256SUMS digests, commands without ids, codes, field names, booleans, counts and durations are here.
